### How You Can Know God Is Real
Author: Noelle Kirchner
Site: Crosswalk.com (iBelieve Truth: A Devotional for Women)
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women-may-12.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:1
Points:
- A child's question about whether God is real invites reflection on how faith is experienced.
- God satisfies the deep inner void that imperfect human relationships cannot fill.
- The presence of God is encountered through genuine acts of love and timely words in Scripture.
- Biblical assurance functions like reliable evidence, confirming that Christian hope is trustworthy.
- God invites anyone seeking Him with their whole heart to discover His reality personally.

### Cultivating the Faith to Keep Going
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com (The Crosswalk Devotional)
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/cultivating-the-faith-to-keep-going-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:1
Points:
- Even when grief threatens to overwhelm us, faith gives purpose and strength to persevere.
- God provides believers with steadfast hope that endures through difficult circumstances.
- Doubts and spiritual dry spells can be honestly brought before the Lord.
- Daily prayer and immersion in Scripture cultivate confidence and deeper trust in God.
- Anchoring our assurance in God empowers us to navigate trials without losing heart.
